translations: So show Me what have created
puzzle.hint: Luqman's timeless counsel to his son: devoted worship, commanding good and rejecting evil, patience, and reliance upon Allah alone.
puzzle.arabic: هَـٰذَا خَلْقُ ٱللَّهِ فَأَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦ ۚ بَلِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
puzzle.verseEn: This is the creation of Allāh. So show Me what those other than Him have created. Rather, the wrongdoers are in clear error.
